question: The author of Tarikh-i-Mubarak Shahi, Yahya Sirhindi claims that the founder of ________ dynasty of Delhi sultanate was a descendant of Prophet Muhammad.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sayyid**__

• **Yahya Sirhindi**, the author of Tarikh-i-Mubarak Shahi, claims that the founder of the **Sayyid dynasty** of the Delhi Sultanate was a descendant of Prophet Muhammad.
